title: 第一卷 第1章 下山第一卷 第2章 哭瞎了
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
“师姐！不行！现在绝对不行！
我还得根据师父的要求死守精关……”
叶青云望着近在咫尺的绝色美人，惊呼道。
“别管那糟老头子，我们继续……”
话落，绝色女子的动作愈发粗鲁。
就在临门一脚的时候，叶青云身子一个哆嗦，猛地睁开眼！
只见眼前碧空如洗，朵朵白云。
叶青云呼出一口浊气。
“原来只是一个梦啊……
也对，师姐前些日子都已经下山了。”
叶青云满脸唏嘘，不知是在回味刚才的梦境，还是在思念师姐。
忽然，一位身穿长袍，精神矍铄的老者出现在叶青云的视线中。
叶青云一个鱼打挺起身，恭敬道。
“师父！”
老者伫立于山之巅，双手负于身后，眺望远方。
他周身云雾缭绕，似有谪仙之姿！
“徒儿！我的本领你已尽数领悟！
现在是你下山的时候了！”
下山？

叶青云闻言，表情一凌！
五年前，他被女友设计陷害，抽血，丢下悬崖！
原以为必死无疑的他，竟被身边的老者所救。
这五年来，叶青云一直跟着老者在这武清山修行。
医术，武道，阵法，符箓……
叶青云都一一掌握！
他在这林林总总方面的天赋非常高，让老者都叹为观止！
“这是你心心念的百宝袋，拿去吧！”
老者说着，把一个巴掌大，刻着精美纹理的布袋丢给叶青云。
叶青云接过袋子，一打开，从里面拿出一把身长七尺，通体雪白的长剑，目露惊讶。
“白虹？！”
接着，叶青云又拿出一个木盒。
打开一看，里面有八枚针！
四枚银针，四枚金针。
“生死八针？！”
“战神令？！”
“……”
叶青云看见一件又一件被师父藏起来的宝贝出现在他面前，
他心中明白，这一次师父来真的了！
这山，他今日非下不可了！

“徒儿，你是我收的八个徒弟中天赋最高的，
各个方面的天赋，即便是为师，都自叹不如。”

"Sister! No! Absolutely not now!
I still have to defend Jingguan according to Master’s requirements..."
Ye Qingyun looked at the stunning beauty so close and exclaimed.
"Don't worry about that bad old man, let's continue..."
After saying this, the stunning woman's movements became more and more rough.
Just when he was about to finish, Ye Qingyun shuddered and opened his eyes suddenly!
I saw a clear blue sky and white clouds in front of me.
Ye Qingyun exhaled a thick breath.
"It turned out to be just a dream...
That's right, senior sister has gone down the mountain a few days ago. "
Ye Qingyun's face was filled with sadness. He didn't know whether he was recalling the dream just now or missing his senior sister.
Suddenly, an energetic old man wearing robes appeared in Ye Qingyun's sight.
Ye Qingyun straightened up and said respectfully.
"Master!"
The old man stood on the top of the mountain, with his hands behind his back, looking into the distance.
He was surrounded by clouds and mist, as if he was an immortal!
"Disciple! You have understood all my abilities!
It's time for you to come down! "
Going down the mountain?
When Ye Qingyun heard this, his expression changed!
Five years ago, he was framed by his girlfriend, had his blood drawn, and was thrown off a cliff!
He thought he was certain to die, but was saved by the old man beside him.
For the past five years, Ye Qingyun has been practicing in Wuqing Mountain with the old man.
Medical skills, martial arts, formations, talismans...
Ye Qingyun mastered them all!
His talents in all these aspects are so high that even the old people are amazed!
"This is the treasure bag you cherish so much, take it!"
The old man said, throwing a palm-sized cloth bag with exquisite textures to Ye Qingyun.
Ye Qingyun took the bag, opened it, and took out a seven-foot-long, snow-white sword from inside, his eyes showing surprise.
"Bai Hong?!"
Then, Ye Qingyun took out another wooden box.
When I opened it, there were eight needles inside!
Four silver needles, four gold needles.
"Eight needles of life and death?!"
"Order of the God of War?!"
"..."
Ye Qingyun saw one treasure after another hidden by his master appearing in front of him.
He knew in his heart that this time the master was here for real!
He had to go down this mountain today!
"Disciple, you are the most talented among the eight disciples I have accepted.
He is talented in all aspects, even as a teacher, he is inferior to him. "
